data_gaps.reason: No supplied page states whether the revised conversion price may be below net asset value or par value.
The supplied pages state that shareholders holding the convertible bonds shall abstain, but do not state whether bondholders must abstain in a bondholder meeting.
No supplied page states whether a net asset floor applies to the downward revision of the conversion price.
No supplied page states whether a par value floor applies to the downward revision of the conversion price.
The supplied pages state one exercise per interest year after first satisfaction but do not provide a separate annual exercise limit field value.

The supplied pages state a continuous 30 trading day observation window for the conditional put, but the schema field is unresolved because the same pages do not separately label it as a put observation window distinct from the trigger description.

The supplied pages state at least 15 trading days below 70% for the conditional put, but the schema field is unresolved because the same pages do not separately label it as a required-days field distinct from the trigger description.

The supplied pages describe the downward revision trigger and floor price but do not state a distinct adjustment-day treatment rule for the revision observation window beyond the general adjustment-day calculation in the conversion price adjustment section.
No supplied page states whether the revised conversion price may be below net asset value or par value.
The supplied pages state that shareholders holding the convertible bonds shall abstain, but do not state whether bondholders must abstain in a bondholder meeting.
No supplied page states whether a net asset floor applies to the downward revision of the conversion price.
No supplied page states whether a par value floor applies to the downward revision of the conversion price.
The supplied pages state one exercise per interest year after first satisfaction but do not provide a separate annual exercise limit field value.

The supplied pages state a continuous 30 trading day observation window for the conditional put, but the schema field is unresolved because the same pages do not separately label it as a put observation window distinct from the trigger description.

The supplied pages state at least 15 trading days below 70% for the conditional put, but the schema field is unresolved because the same pages do not separately label it as a required-days field distinct from the trigger description.
The supplied pages provide the accrued interest formula for redemption but do not state a separate accrued-interest redemption rule field value.

The supplied pages state redemption within five trading days after maturity, but the schema field is unresolved because the same pages do not separately label it as a maturity redemption window days field distinct from the maturity redemption clause.

The supplied pages state a continuous 30 trading day observation window for conditional redemption, but the schema field is unresolved because the same pages do not separately label it as a redemption observation window distinct from the trigger description.

The supplied pages state at least 15 trading days at or above 130% for conditional redemption, but the schema field is unresolved because the same pages do not separately label it as a required-days field distinct from the trigger description.
